_comment: Messages Morphly shows its users. Fetched at runtime, so a notice reaches versions that already exist without a release. Keep the list short and remove a notice once it has done its work: every entry here interrupts somebody. `maxVersion` reaches only the people still running an affected build; `platforms` narrows further. See app/src/main/notices.js.

notices.title: Linux: please update to 0.5.2.
notices.body: In this version the illustration library inside Morphly is lost after the first launch, because an AppImage mounts itself in a new place each time it starts. 0.5.2 fixes it and repairs the setting.
